messages.subject: Diamond floor saw — delivery options?
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm looking at renting a diamond floor saw. Do you deliver to Oulu or would I need to come pick it up from the depot?

Thanks,
Sanna-Maria Kurtti

messages.subject: Petrol pressure washer availability
messages.body:
Hi there,

Could you check if you have a petrol pressure washer available for hire? I'd be picking up from Kempele as usual.

Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Delivery scheduling problem
messages.body:
Hello,

I wanted to let you know about the delivery on my last rental. The driver came at completely the wrong time and I had to rearrange my whole day waiting around. This was a scheduling mistake on your end.

I've been a customer since 2016 and this is really disappointing.

Esko Väyrynen

messages.subject: Re: Delivery scheduling problem
messages.body:
Hi Esko,

I looked into this and you're right, it was a scheduling mix-up on our side. That shouldn't have happened and I'm sorry you had to waste your time waiting.

To make it right — your next order will include free delivery, on us. Just mention this email when you book and we'll make sure the delivery fee is waived.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Delivery scheduling problem
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm placing a new order and would like to confirm that the free delivery Petri Isokangas promised me is applied. He said the delivery fee would be waived on my next order because of the scheduling problem.

Please confirm.

Esko Väyrynen

messages.subject: Generator safety issue
messages.body:
We had a problem with the generator we're renting from you. Our operator touched the casing and received an electric shock. He wasn't seriously injured but the potential was obviously there.

The unit has been isolated and we are not using it. Please advise how you want to handle this — we need either a replacement or an immediate inspection.

Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy

messages.subject: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
Calling about this too but putting it in writing so there's a record. One of our guys got an electric shock from the generator we're renting. Touched the metal casing and got a clear jolt through his arm. He seems alright but we've pulled the machine out of use.

This needs to be dealt with today.

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
Got your message and the call. We're treating this as priority — I've flagged the unit and the service team will be in contact today about inspecting or collecting it.

Please keep it disconnected and out of use until then.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
While we're at it — we got a 220 EUR damage charge on the plate compactor from booking RB-20265862. We don't agree with that, the wear was from normal use. Can you waive the charge?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Urgent — shock from rented generator
messages.body:
One more thing. We need to book some site fencing, about 50 metres. What are the delivery options to our site?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Pricing question before next booking
messages.body:
Hi,

Before we book our next lot of equipment I wanted to flag something. We've been quoted a better rate for the same gear from another supplier. We've been hiring from you for years and would prefer to stay, but the price difference is hard to ignore.

Any room to work on the pricing?

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pricing question before next booking
messages.body:
Hi,

Thanks for bringing this up, and for your loyalty over the years. We'd rather keep your business than lose it over a pricing gap.

We'll match the price you've been offered. When you place the next booking, send me the details and I'll make sure it goes through at the matched rate.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator
Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pricing question before next booking
messages.body:
Going ahead with the booking now. Petri Isokangas agreed to match the lower price we were quoted elsewhere — can you confirm that'll be applied when the booking is set up?

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy
